name: lvx_object_delete

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-11-4.100.155 IDB: lv_obj_delete: sets the deleting flag (+51 & 0x10), sends LV_EVENT_DELETE (36), deletes the children recursively, unlinks the object from its parent or screen list and frees it. lv_obj_clean (0xc384db4) calls it per child.

notes: Address corrected by EVID-UI-4155-MSGBOX-001; the earlier CANDIDATE address was a different function. Target-private UI host use only; device probe pending. Device verified for the UI host (EVID-UI-4155-DEVICE-001); policy stays restricted.

promotion.device_probe: Maintainer-reported on-device run of the UI host on a real Xiaomi Band 11, firmware 4.100.155 (EVID-UI-4155-DEVICE-001, 2026-10-19)
